root_idea.summary: The root denotes profusion, copiousness, and the abundance associated with plentiful water, fertility, and prosperity.
root_idea.development: Its central sense is abundant water or rain; the lexical evidence extends this to well-watered land and flourishing herbage, ample circumstances, generosity, vigorous running, and several specialized derivative uses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested adjective is displayed under the normalized citation form غَدَقٌ rather than its accusative occurrence غَدَقًا.

senses.definition: Abundant or copious, specifically describing water.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction ماءً غَدَقًا, the adjective qualifies water; the lexical evidence does not restrict this use to rain alone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To abound or become copious, said of a spring or source, rain, a rainy year, or a place's rain, dew, moisture, or water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verbal use describing the occurrence or increase of abundant moisture or water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abounding in water or intensely moist and irrigated; flourishing, fresh, juicy, or moist when applied to herbage, a spring, or land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of well-watered natural features, land, and herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to abound in herbage or the produce of the earth, or to become moistened by abundant water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal use specifically describing land and its resulting vegetation or moisture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have much saliva or slaver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal use describing excessive salivation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ample, plentiful, or copious, applied to life and circumstances, a year, water, or speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can describe an ample state of life or a productive year; it is also reported more generally of what is copious, including water and speech.
Used in conventional expressions describing running or a running gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Generous, bountiful, or munificent when applied to a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a person's liberal or large disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Long-bodied, when applied to a horse.
Soft or tender, associated with youth; also reported of a boy who has not reached puberty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a youth or young man, to youthfulness, or, in one reported specification, to a prepubescent boy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The young one of the lizard called ضَبّ, after the stage termed حِسْل.
